text: Below Mount Unebi, at Kashihara, Iwarebiko built a palace whose pillars, the chronicle says, were driven into the bedrock.
spoken: Below Mount Oo-neh-bee, at Kah-shee-hah-rah, Ee-wah-reh-bee-ko built a palace whose pillars, the chronicle says, were driven into the bedrock.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, krótkie słowo (1 syl.)

pauzy.uwaga: brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
brak pauzy w nagraniu — zostaje bez pauzy
